desc: Implement the monotonic-stack solution end-to-end in the starter code.
Implement the O(1) helper that counts valid left/right extension pairs with length at most k.
Compute previous and next boundary arrays for subarray minimums with leftmost-minimum tie-breaking.
Compute previous and next boundary arrays for subarray maximums with leftmost-maximum tie-breaking.
Sum each element's minimum and maximum contributions using boundary distances and the length-limited count helper.
Run the current solution on the provided sample tests and edge cases (k = 1, duplicates, negative values, all-equal arrays) and report a SAMPLE TESTS verdict.
If the sample tests fail, debug the count_valid formula or tie-breaking; if needed, switch to a divide-and-conquer approach for crossing subarrays under the length cap.
